resources.string: Waiting for your computer…\n\nKeep this screen open and start Extraspace on your desktop.
Choose the newest decoded frame on this device when several are ready. May reduce lag under load. Desktop capture and encoding still run on the computer.

ADB: Enable USB debugging, accept the computer authorization prompt, and turn on Extra Display on the PC. The PC opens and refreshes this app automatically.

USB accessory: Choose USB accessory in the PC’s USB Connection menu, connect a data cable, and allow USB access here. USB debugging is optional.

Your device ID lets the PC remember display position, GNOME scale and ExtraSpace preferences. Reinstalling or clearing app data creates a new ID. Use Android Back to open this screen during streaming.
Allow this computer to display its desktop?
ExtraSpace will receive video and send your touches over USB. Camera use requires a separate Android camera permission.
USB accessory access denied. Tap Retry connection to allow it.
Waiting for USB accessory. Select USB accessory on the PC, then connect the cable.
Accept the Android USB access prompt to start displaying.
